note: Curated HARD dependencies. Edge source->target means: if `source` fails, `target` is structurally impacted because its effectiveness or evidence logically depends on `source`. Weights are dependency strength (0-1). These are the only edges that propagate FAILURE; NIST-related and shared-concept edges are treated as soft.

edges.rationale: Encryption at rest depends on cryptographic key management.
Transmission confidentiality depends on key management.
Protection of audit information relies on encryption at rest.
Audit log protection relies on access enforcement limiting who can read/alter logs.
System backups must be encrypted at rest to be protected.
Access enforcement cannot be correct without managed accounts.
Least privilege depends on account management defining who exists and their roles.
Identification & authentication depends on authenticator (credential) management.
Access enforcement presumes identities are authenticated.
Remote access security depends on user authentication.
Remote access confidentiality depends on transmission protection.
Audit review is impossible without event logging.
Meaningful audit review depends on sufficient audit record content.
System monitoring depends on events being logged.
There is nothing to protect under AU-9 unless events are logged.
Incident handling depends on system monitoring to detect incidents.
Incident detection depends on audit review.
Continuous monitoring depends on system monitoring telemetry.
Continuous monitoring depends on ongoing audit review.
Vulnerability scanning can only cover assets present in the component inventory.
Configuration change control depends on an established baseline configuration.
Configuration settings enforcement depends on a baseline to enforce against.
Flaw remediation depends on vulnerability scanning to identify flaws.
System recovery/reconstitution depends on the existence of backups.
Remote access authorization depends on managed accounts.
Encryption at rest depends on approved cryptographic implementation.
Transmission confidentiality depends on approved cryptographic implementation.

iso_bridge.note: Curated edges use NIST IDs; impact propagates to mapped ISO controls automatically via the shared-concept crosswalk.
